# Getting Started {#getting-started}

These two pages take you from nothing to a working terminal, in the order you'll
need them. If you only want a parser or an encoder, read the first
page and then go straight to @ref api_building_blocks "Building Blocks" or @ref
api_input "Input".

- @subpage installing - Get the library and link it into your program.
- @subpage first-terminal - Create a terminal, write bytes into it, read the
  screen back, and draw it.
